referenceStatus: No new growth-reference attachments supplied for G10; follows the existing project species plan and accepted G09 visual direction.
direction: Sculpted closed petals, crisp registered leaf/petal textures, saturated albedo, curved connected floral stems; five growth stages and separate harvest.

species.Sunflower: Tall thick stem; broad heart-shaped serrated leaves; two yellow ray rings around brown phyllotactic florets; striped seed.
species.Chrysanthemum: Branched compact shrub; deeply lobed leaves; dense golden incurving spoon petals; spherical buds.
species.Dahlia: Opposite compound serrated leaves; coral pink pointed cupped petals in overlapping concentric rings; round green buds.
species.Marigold: Pinnate foliage of narrow serrated leaflets; short branched shrub; orange ruffled flower heads; elongated ribbed calyx and black tipped seed.

existingGameplay: Preserved; prepared art has separate Unity visual prefabs for review.
